title: Roots identification and unit normalization for a supplied pure comparison
statement: Let ell, W, D and quotient-normalized evaluated units eta be as in [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and [lem-sfb-diagonal-evaluation-unit], with the canonical Ext structures [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext]. Put M=G_m^comp, P_n=(Z/ell^(n+1))(1), and kappa_n the compared positive Kummer class [def-sfb-kummer-strict-adjunct-data]. For every supplied strict p-adic system H and isomorphism b:T(M[1])≅H[2], there exist an underlying roots-tower isomorphism roots and p-adic-linear isomorphisms t_n:H_n≅F_n(P_n). They satisfy kummerRootNormalization, and the composite of eta at M[1] with evaluated b, the exact-forgetting shift and single-object comparisons, and t_n with inverse finite-forgetting comparison shifted by two equals negative kappa_n[1] followed by inverse shift addition. No H or b is constructed or asserted to exist.

source.place: Step (3), target paragraph, and step (4), normalization of the unit at shifted comparison units.

proof.text: The actual coefficient record has the signed Kummer Kernel property and the ordinary root-normalized FiniteLift property. Its PureTriangles property follows, for each supplied H and b, from the arbitrary-sheaf multiplication-triangle computation. The concrete component theorems package these already stated arguments with the actual record parameters.

Apply kummer_normalization_of_coefficients to these three properties. Its proof compares the two distinguished multiplication triangles, lifts the third isomorphism by full faithfulness of shifted singles, proves naturality by monic cancellation, and uses the scalar lift to obtain the precise negative shifted unit equation. Expanding the real coefficient record and named conclusion gives exactly the former concrete normalization proposition.

proof_origin.place: Steps (3) and (4): comparison of multiplication triangles, monic cancellation for transitions, and finite p-adic scalar lifting.
